title: Forensic Photo - Security Patrol Log Entry Timestamp Detail (EV003/EV008)
prompt:
1) Function (1 sentence)
Create a forensic-quality close-up photograph documenting the timestamp detail on a security patrol log entry.

2) Scene / Composition (3–5 sentences; include subject percentage in frame)
A single paper security patrol log page lies flat on a neutral, unpatterned tabletop with no other identifiable objects present. The camera frames a tight close-up of one log entry line where the handwritten time and date fields are visible, occupying 70% of the frame, with surrounding lines slightly visible for context. A small, plain, unmarked metric scale (no branding) is placed parallel to the entry line along the bottom edge of the frame. Include a subtle forensic annotation tag in-frame (a small blank evidence marker card with only an arrow and hash marks, no text) pointing toward the timestamp field. Lighting is raking from camera-left to emphasize pen impressions and paper texture while maintaining readable contrast.

3) Angle & Distance (strict numeric values)
Angle: 90° top-down; subject distance: 0.45 m from lens to paper.

4) Optics & Technique (lens mm, f/, 1/x s, ISO, WB K, focus, DOF)
Lens: 60 mm macro; aperture f/8; shutter 1/125 s; ISO 200; white balance 5000 K. Focus locked on the handwritten timestamp characters with deep enough depth of field to keep the entire timestamp field and adjacent printed line sharp. Forensic clarity, minimal noise, true-to-life color.

5) Mandatory elements (labels/markers/timestamps already present in the case)
Only the patrol log’s existing printed form fields and the handwritten timestamp entry are visible; no additional labels, case identifiers, camera IDs, or added timestamps.

6) Negatives (objective list of what MUST NOT appear)
No real names, no signatures with identifiable names, no faces, no hands/fingers, no logos/brands, no official badges or seals, no barcodes/QR codes, no real addresses, no phone numbers, no license plates, no additional documents, no digital overlay timestamps, and do not write the evidenceId or any caseId in the image.

7) Acceptance checklist (objective, verifiable bullets)
- Single image, close-up, top-down 90° view of a patrol log entry timestamp area.
- The timestamp field is sharp and legible; subject occupies ~70% of the frame.
- Raking light from left clearly reveals paper texture/pen impressions without glare.
- A plain, unmarked metric scale is visible and aligned near the bottom edge.
- A small blank annotation marker (arrow/hash only, no text) indicates the timestamp field.
- No extra timestamps, IDs, names, logos, faces, or other prohibited identifiers appear.
